title_zh: 推箱子的技术深度：关卡生成、死锁检测与求解器的实现
title_en: Sokoban's Hidden Complexity: Level Generation, Deadlock Detection, and Building a Solver
desc_zh: 推箱子看起来简单——把箱子推到目标位置。但实现一个好的推箱子游戏远比想象中复杂：关卡怎么生成、死锁怎么检测、提示系统的求解器怎么做……这篇文章把推箱子从「会玩」到「会做」之间的所有技术细节全部拆开讲清楚。
desc_en: Sokoban looks simple — push boxes to target positions. But implementing it well is far more complex than it appears: how do you generate valid levels, detect deadlocks before they happen, and build a hint system with an actual solver? This article covers everything between 'knowing how to play' and 'knowing how to build it.'
